AiplaHelpCopilot.title: AIPLA Help
AiplaHelpCopilot.emptyText: Ask me how to use AIPLA — create a class, build an activity, add materials, use the co-pilot, or (for researchers) the research views. I answer in Danish or English. The full guides are under Guides.

TeacherMaterialsPage.title: Materials
TeacherMaterialsPage.subtitle: Upload, organise and read the documents your activities draw on.

TeacherSettingsPage.title: Settings
TeacherSettingsPage.elsewhereTitle: Everything else lives where it applies
TeacherSettingsPage.elsewhereBody: Per-class settings (the tutor, voice and read-aloud language) are on each class page; per-activity settings (language, elements, materials) are in the activity builder. The defaults above are only a starting point for those — they never override them.

LensConfigPanel.title: Research · judge lenses
LensConfigPanel.intro: Competency-rubric judges (1.1.57) — researcher-only; nothing here is shown to teachers or students. Prompt edits bump the version, and every score is stamped with the version that produced it.
LensConfigPanel.modelLabel: Judge model (from the platform's curated list)
LensConfigPanel.modelRoadmap: Gemini for now. Multi-provider judges (local / self-hosted, Ollama-focused) are on the roadmap.
LensConfigPanel.overrideLabel: Judge prompt override (empty = the default above; saving bumps the version)
LensConfigPanel.overridePlaceholder: Empty → the default prompt above is used. Click “Copy into editor” to start from it.
LensConfigPanel.overrideNote: The override replaces only these instructions. The rubric categories, your anchor pack, the attribution, and the student's evidence are always appended automatically.
LensConfigPanel.resetDone: Reset to the code default — version bumped.
LensConfigPanel.abstained: Abstained — {reason}. This is the designed outcome for an uncalibrated or evidence-less session, not an error.
LensConfigPanel.defaultPromptInUse: Default prompt (currently in use) — click to view

ProgrammeBudgetPanel.title: Programme daily budget
ProgrammeBudgetPanel.intro: Across every teacher. Sits under the project’s hard quota and above the per-teacher monthly caps — it is the only thing that can see a bad day across all classes at once.
ProgrammeBudgetPanel.noBudget: No budget is set. The per-teacher caps and the project quota still apply; this knob adds a programme-wide daily ceiling on top of them.
ProgrammeBudgetPanel.whenReachedAria: Action when the budget is reached

TeacherProgrammePage.rolesIntro: A role is a claim on the account (researcher, programme admin, platform admin). It is separate from a spend grant on purpose — a role must never silently become a budget — so a person can hold a role and still be a visitor. This list joins the two.
TeacherProgrammePage.rolesEmpty: Nobody on this environment holds a role claim.
TeacherProgrammePage.roleTitle_researcher: Cross-class read: research view, cost dashboard
TeacherProgrammePage.roleTitle_programmeAdmin: May grant spend on the programme's behalf, within bounds
TeacherProgrammePage.viaDelegatedTitle: Granted in-app by a programme admin, under the delegated bounds
TeacherProgrammePage.spendTitle: Spend so far this period, against the cap
TeacherProgrammePage.registerEmpty: The register is empty — which means every account on this environment is a visitor, including established teachers. That is almost certainly not what you want on a live environment.
TeacherProgrammePage.uncappedTitle: No per-teacher limit. Bounded only by the shared project quota.
